# Trim Audio

- Route: `/tools/trim-audio`
- Kind: `tool`
- Category: `audio`
- Slug: `trim-audio`

## Summary

Cut an MP3, WAV or any recording to a start and end time, with a waveform to pick the points, and download just that part. (Audio tools)

## Details

The chorus for a ringtone, the one good minute of a two-hour recording, the sound bite without the intro: trimming is the audio edit everyone needs. Media Manipulator shows a waveform, lets you drag start and end points, cuts on our servers with FFmpeg, and exports in any format with optional fades.
### What it does
- Cuts any audio file to a start and end time chosen on a waveform.
- Fade in and fade out so the cut does not click.
- The cut comes back as MP3, WAV, FLAC, M4A, OGG or Opus.
- Combine with volume, normalise and EQ in the same pass.
### How to use it
1. Upload audio: Any common format.
2. Set the range: Drag markers on the waveform.
3. Convert: FFmpeg cuts and encodes.
4. Download: Save the clip.
### Supported formats
- Input: mp3, wav, m4a, aac, ogg, opus, flac, alac, ac3, wma
- Output: mp3, wav, flac, aac, ogg, opus
### Technical details
- The cut is sample-accurate; the output is re-encoded in the format you choose.
- A fade of 0.05 to 0.2 seconds removes clicks at the cut points.
- For a video, use the Video trimmer; for a waveform video of the result, the Audio waveform generator.
### Use cases
- Ringtone: Cut the chorus and add a fade.
- Sound bite: Pull one sentence from an interview.
- Remove a bad start: Drop the first 10 seconds of a memo.
- Sample: Isolate a hit or a phrase.
### FAQ
Q: Can I type exact times?
A: Yes. The trim dialog has start and end fields as well as the draggable markers.
Q: Will the cut click?
A: Add a short fade in and out in Basic processing to avoid it.
Q: Can I keep the original quality?
A: Choose WAV or FLAC output to avoid a lossy re-encode.
Q: Can I cut out the middle?
A: One range per pass; run the tool twice and join the parts in Darkroom.

## Routing

When to send a visitor here: Use for cutting an audio file down to one part: a ringtone from a song chorus, the one good minute of a long recording, a sound bite without the intro. Start and end points are picked on a waveform, with optional fade in and fade out.
When to send them elsewhere: To cut a video rather than an audio file use Video Trimmer (video-trimmer). To get the soundtrack out of a video first use Extract Audio from Video (extract-audio-from-video). To change only the format without cutting use Audio Converter (audio-converter).
Related tools: video-trimmer (same job for video files); extract-audio-from-video (pull audio out of a video before trimming); audio-converter (change format without cutting); normalize-audio (level the loudness of the trimmed clip)
